progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fs4 and dwells most on Fs in Naghmeh-e Maghlub. The line peaks at Fs4 (358.6 Hz) at 0:26.2. It closes on D4, not the tonic (E4 → E4 → E4 → Fs4 → E4 → D4).
